targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  timestamp AS time,
  value
FROM process_metrics
WHERE station_name = '${station_name}'
  AND metric_name = REPLACE(REPLACE('${metric_name}', '${station_name}_', ''), '_view', '')
  AND timestamp BETWEEN
        to_timestamp(${anomaly_time}::bigint / 1000.0) - INTERVAL '0.4 minute'
    AND to_timestamp(${anomaly_time}::bigint / 1000.0) + INTERVAL '0.4 minute'
ORDER BY timestamp;

SELECT
  time,
  mean,
  upper_3sigma AS ucl,
  lower_3sigma AS lcl
FROM ${metric_name}
WHERE time BETWEEN
      to_timestamp(${anomaly_time}::bigint / 1000.0) - INTERVAL '0.4 minute'
  AND to_timestamp(${anomaly_time}::bigint / 1000.0) + INTERVAL '0.4 minute'
ORDER BY time;
